criteria.deficiency: Non-blocking, shared with the reference. Task.finished changed from completed >= total (base progress.py:477-479) to finished_time is not None (generated progress.py:497). Once set, finished_time is never cleared when completed drops below total (progress.py:835-836 only sets it), so finished becomes sticky. This affects FinishedText (progress.py:249), time_remaining (progress.py:528-529), and Progress.finished (progress.py:616). This is a behavioral change from the original. Because the reference has identical semantics, I did not fail the candidate for it. Reference-only hunks that the candidate omits (markup.py 'from None', the version bump, color/console/docs cosmetics, the process_renderables 'raise', and the palette __main__ demo) are unrelated to this feature and are not exercised by the reference tests, so they are not counted as failures.
